Text.name: intro
Text.value: Read the customer message and select the main issue they want help with. Choose exactly one intent. If no reasonable decision is possible, skip the item.

Text.name: rule1
Text.value: 1. Read the complete customer message before selecting a label.

Text.name: rule2
Text.value: 2. Identify the main issue the customer wants help with. Focus on the meaning of the message, not just individual keywords.

Text.name: rule3
Text.value: 3. Select the single intent that best describes the main issue. Use the label definitions when unsure about the differences between categories.

Text.name: rule4
Text.value: 4. If several issues are mentioned, prioritize the customer's main request. If there is no clear primary issue, skip the item.

Text.name: rule5
Text.value: 5. Base your judgment only on the information provided. Do not assume missing details. If none of the nine intents fits, skip the item.

Text.name: def_passcode
Text.value: Forgotten passcode: The customer has forgotten their passcode or cannot access their account because of it.

Text.name: def_transfer_pending
Text.value: Pending transfer: A bank transfer has been initiated but is still pending or processing.

Text.name: def_transfer_not_received
Text.value: Transfer not received: Money was sent, but the intended recipient reports that it has not arrived.

Text.name: def_card_pending
Text.value: Pending payment: A card payment has been attempted or made but is still shown as pending.

Text.name: def_card_declined
Text.value: Declined payment: A specific card payment was attempted but rejected or declined.

Text.name: def_card_duplicated
Text.value: Charged twice: The customer reports that the same card payment appears to have been charged more than once.

Text.name: def_cash_pending
Text.value: Pending withdrawal: A cash withdrawal was requested or attempted but remains pending or incomplete.

Text.name: def_cash_unrecognized
Text.value: Unrecognized withdrawal: The customer does not recognize a cash withdrawal from their account.

Text.name: def_card_acceptance
Text.value: Card acceptance: The customer asks whether their card can be used by a merchant or in a particular payment situation.

Text.name: example1
Text.value: I forgot my passcode and cannot log in. - Account access: Forgotten passcode

Text.name: example2
Text.value: My transfer is still processing after two days. - Bank transfer: Pending

Text.name: example3
Text.value: I sent money, but my friend has not received it. - Bank transfer: Not received

Text.name: example4
Text.value: My card was rejected at the supermarket. - Card payment: Declined

Text.name: edge1
Text.value: I forgot my passcode, and my transfer has not arrived. I need help with both.

Text.name: edge2
Text.value: If two independent requests have no clear primary intent, skip the item rather than guessing.

Header.value: Choose the primary customer support intent

Choice.hint: The customer has forgotten their passcode or cannot access their account because of it.
The customer initiated a bank transfer, but it is still pending or being processed.
A transfer was sent, but the intended recipient has not received the money.
A card payment is still pending or processing.
A card transaction was attempted but declined or rejected.
The same card payment appears to have been charged more than once.
A cash withdrawal is still pending or incomplete.
The customer does not recognize a cash withdrawal from their account.
The customer asks whether their card can be used in a particular payment situation.
